name: Fiona Campbell
bio:
Fiona's journey into motorsport wasn't traditional. With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Glasgow, she initially worked in the finance sector. However, her lifelong passion for racing, fueled by watching Formula 1 with her dad, led her to seek a role where she could combine her technical skills with her enthusiasm for motorsport. She joined the Junior Kart Team three years ago and has since revolutionized their IT infrastructure, implementing systems that improved data analysis and communication across the team.

Her pragmatic approach ensures that IT solutions are not just cutting-edge but also reliable and user-friendly. Fiona's focus is on empowering the team with the best tools to make informed decisions, whether it's optimizing kart setups or improving driver performance tracking. She believes that a robust IT infrastructure is the backbone of a successful racing team, providing a competitive edge on and off the track. Her ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights makes her a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Fiona has a determined look and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Obsessively organizes her desk by color.
Drinks copious amounts of Earl Grey tea.
